entries.question: Free structure
entries.answer:

However, I can give you some general information and direct you to the most likely place to find the details:

*   **Where to Look:**

        *   [Courses/ Admission](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)
        *   [Faculty of Medical Sciences](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php)

    *   **Contact the Admissions Office:** If you can't find the information online, I recommend contacting the KGMU admissions office directly. You can usually find their contact information (phone number or email) on the website.

**General Information (This may not be current - always check the official sources above):**

*   **Fees Vary:** The fees will vary depending on the course (MBBS, BDS, Nursing, postgraduate programs, etc.).
*   **Components of Fees:** The fees typically include tuition fees, registration fees, examination fees, and other charges.
*   **Payment Schedule:** The payment schedule (when fees are due) will be specified.
*   **Other Charges:** There might be additional charges for things like hostel accommodation (if applicable), library fees, and other services.

**To get the *accurate* and *current* fee structure, please visit the KGMU website or contact the admissions office.**
